headline: US futures point to a higher open with small caps leading as Nvidia probe headlines and wholesale inventories data loom
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) +0.41%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) +0.71%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) +0.08%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) +1.01% indicate a gap-up open with small caps outperforming and the Nasdaq 100 lagging.
- FROG (FROG) trades roughly flat pre-market after beating Q3 revenue estimates with 31% growth.
- DKNG (DKNG) trades notably lower pre-market following its earnings results, while NRDS (NRDS) and FIVN (FIVN) are roughly unchanged.
- Estee Lauder (EL) trades roughly flat pre-market after raising its guidance.
- Rivian (RIVN) trades roughly flat in pre-market trading after receiving an analyst upgrade.
- Check Point (CHKP) trades roughly flat pre-market after issuing a weak Q4 outlook.
- A MarketWatch note at 4:01 AM ET on an investigation into spy-claims involving Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang adds near-term caution around Nvidia (NVDA) and AI-related stocks.
- Earnings before the bell from CEG (CEG), KKR (KKR), FERG (FERG), MNDY (MNDY), and NRG (NRG) are in focus for initial reactions at the open.
- US wholesale inventories data are scheduled for release at 10:00 AM ET amid an otherwise light economic calendar.
